_comment: The committed demo default -- the bottom of the configuration chain. src/config-loader.js falls back to this file when neither config.js (generated from environment variables) nor config.json (an operator file) is present, so a bare `git clone` plus `python -m http.server` boots into a working app with the demo house and Home Assistant switched off. Copy this file to config.json and edit it to configure a static deployment by hand; config.json is gitignored. Every value here is deliberately inert: no host, no token, no real entity ids.

_fields.enabled: Whether to attempt a Home Assistant connection. Ignored (treated as false) unless both url and token are non-empty -- a half-configured deployment renders a static house rather than failing at runtime.
_fields.url: Base URL of your Home Assistant, e.g. https://homeassistant.example.com. Overridden by the ?haUrl= URL parameter when present.
_fields.fallbackUrl: A second URL tried when url is unreachable, e.g. a VPN hostname. NOT used at all when ?haUrl= is set -- an explicit embedder override means that URL and no other.
_fields.token: A Home Assistant long-lived access token. WARNING: this is served to every browser that can load the page. Only deploy behind authentication. Prefer supplying it via the HOME3D_HA_TOKEN environment variable so it is never written into a file in the repo.
_fields.house: Which profile under houses/ to render. Lowercase letters, digits, _ and -.
_fields.wsReconnectMs: Delay in milliseconds before retrying a dropped websocket.
_fields.pollIntervalMs: REST poll interval in milliseconds, used when the websocket is unavailable.
